A1.justification: Both PDFs are readable 34-page versions of the same work. The main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A-N support reliable comparison without material gaps.

before.justification: v1 reports original graph-clustering experiments, runtime comparisons, ablations, and synthetic ADC-SBM label-recovery results in Section 6 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark experiments, runtime comparisons, ablations, and synthetic recovery results, including the large-graph results in Appendix J.

M1.justification: The Q-MAGC objective, alternating updates, and Q-GCN/Q-VGAE/Q-GMM-VGAE procedures remain unchanged. Section 5 explicitly describes soft assignments as probabilities and hard assignments as binary, clarifying the procedure already described in v1.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same citation, Coauthor, Amazon, ogbn-arxiv, and three Airports datasets. Appendix I retains the same matched, nested, and grouped feature scenarios for synthetic ADC-SBM graphs.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the benchmark, runtime, modularity, and large-graph comparisons. Louvain remains in Table 1 with identical scores; its citation becoming a question mark does not remove the comparator.

E3.justification: Metrics, NMI-based model selection, degree-derived features, full-batch training and large-graph batching are unchanged. Appendix I retains the same graph-generation parameters, feature dimensions, and evaluation scenarios.

E4.justification: The runtime comparisons, modularity/conductance analysis, loss-term ablations, latent-space visualizations, and synthetic robustness analyses are retained. Appendices H, I, and N add no new analytical experiments.

E5.justification: Both versions retain point estimates and plots without reported repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting procedure is added or revised.

E6.justification: Corresponding benchmark scores, runtime curves, ablation curves, and qualitative findings match. For example, Table 1 retains Q-GMM-VGAE NMI scores of 58.7, 47.4, and 34.8 for Cora, CiteSeer, and PubMed; Appendix I retains NMI/ARI/ACC = 1 under all specified synthetic conditions.

T1.justification: The convergence and consistency theorems, their substantive conditions, and the proofs in Appendices A-D are unchanged. Lemma 1's hypothesis sentence is clarified, and notation is standardized, without introducing a new assumption, derivation, or mathematical argument.

C1.justification: The abstract and contribution list retain the same claims about coarsening with modularity, convergence, DC-SBM consistency, GNN integration, and empirical performance. Introduction edits do not materially change their scope.

C2.justification: Section 4 newly states that the objective's consistency analysis applies independently of using GNN optimization or block majorization-minimization. Appendix I adds an explicit rationale for choosing DC-SBM as both analytically tractable and representative of degree heterogeneity. Existing limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Hardware, software versions, synthetic-data generation instructions, and the disclosed code URL are unchanged. Appendix K moves to the next page, while the added soft/hard assignment wording clarifies existing terminology rather than disclosing a new implementation procedure.

R1.justification: The same distinct prior works and substantive research positioning are retained. Duplicate Blondel et al. references are consolidated, and existing works receive additional citation placements; no new literature or comparison framing is introduced.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized prose, grammar, notation, and explanatory edits across the introduction, background, and method sections. Examples include expanding JSD, clarifying iteration notation and soft/hard assignments, and rewording Lemma 1. The section structure remains intact, although Table 1 gains an unresolved Louvain citation.

P2.justification: Figure 1 moves from page 9 to page 10, several captions are shortened, and tables, plots, and surrounding text undergo limited resizing or reflow. Figure content and plotted results remain unchanged; no figures or tables are added or removed.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves readability through cleaner prose, more consistent notation, clearer soft/hard assignment descriptions, and clearer wording of Lemma 1's hypotheses. The added discussion explains the intended scope and motivation of the consistency analysis. These gains are limited, with unchanged scientific evidence and proofs, and are partly offset by the unresolved Louvain citation in Table 1.
